Problem Statement:
Write a program to find all prime numbers within a given range. 
Input Description:
The program takes two integers, start and end, representing the range within which to find prime numbers. 
Output Description:
All prime numbers between start and end inclusive. 
Sample Input:
10 20 
Sample Output:
11 13 17 19
